title: Herbal Gooey Kenyan Prawns Roast
description: A flavorful and aromatic Kenyan dish featuring raw tiger prawns, roasted to perfection with a blend of herbs and spices, served as a solo dinner, shojin-friendly and gooey.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, grated ginger, minced garlic, lemon juice, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the raw tiger prawns to the bowl and toss to coat with the herbal mixture.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the prawns in a single layer.
Roast the prawns in the preheated oven for 8 minutes or until they are pink and cooked through.
Remove the prawns from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley and dill.
Return the prawns to the oven and roast for an additional 1-2 minutes or until the herbs are fragrant.
Remove the prawns from the oven and serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley and dill if desired.
